purpose: Explicit scalar and immediate action-request storage contracts; source changes revoke evidence until reviewed again. Deferred handlers remain separate.
evidence: Source bodies and scalar-push/set helpers reviewed alongside original Ghidra80115228/8011601C/8011604C and bounded original-instruction cases. Read-only helper chains reviewed separately; lookup predecessor writes target a C-stack temporary. Actor/object prefix definitions and vmAddress offset checks bind the shared context lookup; handle-domain branches checked against original Ghidra8011DD38/8011DD78/8011DDB8/80118ACC and twenty-four guarded replacement cases. Coordinate, packed-counter and actor creation-argument helper paths reviewed against original Ghidra80117480/801174B0/80114CC8/8012056C and thirty-five authored original-instruction cases. Twelve action-request wrappers and their two-field scheduling helper reviewed against original Ghidra801167A0 and all twelve original wrapper addresses; twenty-four direct original-instruction request cases guard all VM fields and pending/protected values. Selector-three deferred dispatch and helper chain reviewed against original Ghidra80117098/8000F4C4/801167BC/800120F0 and eight guarded direct-dispatch/scheduler cases. Selector-two startup and waiting helpers reviewed against original Ghidra80116800/80012034; twelve guarded direct/scheduler cases cover numeric tags, original null sentinel, waiting and completion. Player input-mask field names now include synthetic stick flags, separately from permission flags; unchanged prefix layout and the reviewed permission/position reads were rechecked against matching objects before rebinding the two affected header dependencies. Additional permission names for Pikachu/follow selection and stun reaction leave the permission storage and reviewed view/position access unchanged; the two header dependencies were rechecked after strict matching verification. Ten additional permission names retain identical player storage and reviewed view/position accesses; header bindings rechecked after all483 objects and ROM matched. Selector-nine cost admission, root-resource adjustment and HUD helper were checked against Ghidra80116BC4/80014A3C, the authenticated five-record table and fourteen guarded original-instruction startup/poll/completion observations, including distinct actor/root resource records. The root and script actor states are explicitly distinguished. Acknowledgement native and helper checked against Ghidra8011C84C/80119200 and four original-instruction probes, including raw nonboolean word preservation; message fields remain unchanged. Four distance/target append contracts checked against original Ghidra801172D4/80118838/801187E4/8011C674/8011CB38/8011D208/8011DBF8/801177FC/80118B30/8003A5FC/8003A6F0 and twelve guarded original-instruction probes with distinct local/world coordinates, approach clamping, fixed/follow selection and unavailable-target exclusions. The actor-state header replaces only the producer-established four-byte approach sample with f32 and adds its offset assertion; all other declarations remain token-identical. Five further handle-consuming query contracts checked against original Ghidra8011730C/80117388/8011D240/8011D288/80117840/801178EC/8011DCB0/8011DCF8/80117E80/8011EA9C and23 guarded original-instruction observations. Runtime kind130 is authenticated against its retained callback record selecting80027430/8002747C, whose allocation and speed accesses establish the shared four-byte spinner state; six updater observations cover decay, negative retained values, voice-distance endpoints, speed cap and yaw wrap. Independent agent RNG review authenticated original wrapper/helper instructions and fifteen guarded interpreter observations at62bceac: inclusive unit-float endpoints including the observed rounding threshold, unsigned remainder for positive signed bounds, no advancement for nonpositive bounds, numeric conversion and unchanged protected VM storage. Reports retain original ROM/ELF/core/source fingerprints; FCR31 threshold is qualified to observed interpreter rounding.
